participation.context: Wrote the list and did not strike a line.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set the five items down and left every one of them standing.

title: Wrote the five items of the Lent list

description: The legs, and not the names

participation.context: Walked the second turn, refused the names, and started home.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You walked to Finsbury and did not speak a name. You did not buy the horse.

title: Walked to Finsbury

participation.context: Stood at the cleared board and did not put the cat on it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You looked at the shelf, the book, the quire, and the ink.
